search.label: Search the store
search.emptyHint: Try checking the spelling or using fewer words.
search.unavailable: Suggestions are unavailable right now. Press Enter to search anyway.

cart.title: Your bag
cart.emptyBody: Anything you add will wait here until you're ready.
cart.loadError: Your bag could not be loaded.
cart.taxesNote: Taxes and delivery are calculated at checkout.

saved.title: Saved
saved.lede: Things worth a second look. Prices and availability are always current.
saved.emptyBody: Tap the heart on anything worth a second look. Saved items stay on this device.
saved.unavailable: Some saved items are no longer available and have been hidden.
saved.failedBody: Your list is safe on this device. Check your connection and try again.

preferences.title: Region and language
preferences.currencyNote: Checkout is charged in US dollars for now. Other currencies arrive with local pricing.
preferences.detectedHint: Suggested from your connection. Change it any time.

notFound.title: This page wandered off
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the item may have moved.

gate.bagTitle: Sign in to use your bag
gate.bagBody: Your bag is kept with your account, so it follows you to any device. Browsing, searching and saving work without one.
gate.reviewTitle: Sign in to join the conversation
gate.reviewBody: Reviews and questions are tied to an account so everyone can trust them. Reading them never needs one.

category.noResultsHint: It may live in another part of the store.
category.noMatchBody: Try removing a filter or widening the price range.

pdp.returnsBody: Change your mind, no awkward questions.
pdp.deliveryBody: Your delivery date is confirmed at checkout.
pdp.supportBody: Helpful people, when you need one.
pdp.deliveryReturnsBody: Every order is tracked and packed without excess. You'll see the delivery date for your address before you pay, and you can return it within 30 days of delivery.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.emptyBody: Add something first, then come back here.
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.testOutcomeHint: Development payment provider. Never enter card numbers here.
checkout.verifyTitle: Your bank asked for additional verification.
checkout.verifyBody: Complete the provider's step to continue.
checkout.errorUnknown: We couldn't confirm whether the order was placed. Trying again with the same details is safe.
checkout.errorPayment: Your payment wasn't completed. Try again or choose another method.
checkout.assurance: Stock and prices are checked once more before your order is placed.
checkout.summaryNote: Delivery and taxes are included in the final confirmation.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.lede: Receipts, status and the details worth keeping.
orders.emptyBody: When you place one, you'll find every detail here.
orders.confirmedBody: Thank you. We've reserved your items and started preparing them.
orders.paymentConfirmed: Payment confirmed. Your order is on its way to being prepared.
orders.nextPrepare: We prepare and pack your order.
orders.nextStatus: Its status updates here as it moves.
